_note: Google Drive file IDs for the course/free videos, looked up via the Drive API on 2026-07-22. Keyed by SOURCE filename (matches lessons[].src / freeVideos[].srcVideo in asset-manifest.json). build-data.py turns each ID into https://drive.google.com/file/d/<id>/preview for the iframe player. The video files themselves are NEVER copied into this repo. If Crystal re-uploads a video, the ID changes — update it here and re-run tools/build-data.py.
_sharing: Embeds only play for site visitors if the file is shared 'Anyone with the link'. As of 2026-07-22 the checked files are 'anyone: WRITER' — over-permissive (anyone can edit/delete). Should be downgraded to 'anyone: viewer' in Drive; playback works either way.
